host_boundary_cost.scope: VM+Docker backend replaces guest DB cgroup, never added twice. Host app/PG/k6/workload observer and context monitor including their collected child CPU included. VM/context edges up to5s missing; kernel/system services not fully assigned.

chrome_top20_sampled_cpu_percent.scope: Only Chrome processes appearing in each top20 sample; ps CPU is smoothed, not cumulative CPU. Not included in attributed experiment CPU. Browser/background activity was not physically isolated.

observer_cost.definition: During load and bounded recovery drain; post-run snapshot compression excluded. Observer children are ps/docker CLI; Docker daemon/VM not fully isolated.

occupancy_window.definition: Measured cohort reservation created_at to min(terminal_at,observation end after bounded drain). Unresolved rows contribute elapsed time; fully resolved lifetime reported separately.

limitations: Warmup excluded from transaction outcomes; process/DB cumulative cost includes warmup and gaps; compare identical plans.
Process cumulative CPU sampled first-to-last, misses edges; VM/kernel/control child processes not fully included.
PG global-unavailable responses are not logged per key by simulator; app call counters include attempts.
All schema SQL digests captured; cumulative summary is not an event trace.
Purchase time is DB terminal_at; 202 is not purchase throughput; unresolved rows not counted as failed purchases.
cohort_definition: Measured logical inputs joined to durable successful request_results, including committed reservations without a201 response. Deduplicated by reservation ID. HTTP success throughput remains response-based and is separately labeled.
expiry_definition: Reconstructed from DB expiry/attempt-start/terminal timestamps; includes warmup. HELD past TTL until payment attempt or terminal. Not a live commit-instant sample. TTL expiration lag only EXPIRED reservations with no payment attempt.
